completeness_limitations: Loaded from partition outputs; entries absent from those outputs are absent here.
Relationships that arrive without provenance are recorded UNRESOLVED; none is promoted.
Attributes not stated by a partition or overlay are unknown or unresolved, not guessed.
Records that carry no source revision say so (unrecorded) and are counted in the Catalogue Integrity Report.
Informational catalogue only: non-authorizing, authority none, activates nothing, release and production remain on HOLD.

rule_code_registries.headline: none by design: entries and distinct code names are different denominators and are never one number

regeneration.summary: Every committed partition, the manifest and every external artifact are a pure function of the pinned partition outputs and the tool files; rerunning the command on identical inputs reproduces them byte for byte.
